screen.campaignSiegeDescription: Five waves. A settled victory pays campaign rewards.

A right-side preparation panel presents Campaign Siege and Endless, a Start Campaign Siege action, a 2/2 tower roster, and retrofit options. The semantic preparation surface and visible defense markers align broadly, but the scene, lane/range composition, tower families, hero/army deployment, 15-wave battle HUD, roster tray, and overall panel hierarchy differ. The natural Campaign Siege is five waves; the mock shows wave 0/15 preparation.
